methodology.spike: top 10% normalized true-range score vs preceding 60 bars
methodology.sweep: preceding 5-bar extreme taken and close returned inside
methodology.displacement: directional range >=1.5x preceding 20-bar median TR and body fraction >=0.60
methodology.retest: gap touched and directionally closed within 8 bars
methodology.lookahead: features use candles strictly before entry; descriptive only
